source.note: No real product. A generic Japandi visual proxy made for the demo catalogue; it copies no retailer's design and carries no brand.
source.generation: Higgsfield multi_image_to_3d from a four-view AI turnaround sheet generated with the Codex image_gen tool (codex-image.sh); should_texture=true, enable_pbr=true, should_remesh=true, topology=triangle, target_polycount=28000, symmetry_mode=auto, rigging and animation off.
source.postProcessing: @gltf-transform/cli resize --width 1024 --height 1024, then a 90 degree yaw about +Y (scene re-parented under one rotation node) so the arc sweeps along X, then scripts/fit_glb.py per-axis fit (centres the footprint, puts the base at y=0), then emissiveFactor zeroed on the single material.
source.priceProvenance: invented: a plausible demo figure, not a real or quoted price

knownLimitations: No real product. Generic Japandi visual proxy generated from an AI turnaround sheet; the catalogue price is invented, not sourced.

Reconstructed with the arc sweeping along Z (51 x 105 cm footprint), which would have forced a per-axis fit to crush 105 cm of arc into the listing's 40 cm depth. The scene was re-parented under a single 90 degree yaw node before fitting so the arc sweeps along X instead. Lossless: no vertex, index or texture bytes changed.

Fit missed the listing box slightly. Requested 90 x 40 x 190 cm, shipped 93.4 x 45.2 x 184.8 cm at the 10% anisotropy cap; fit_glb.py exited 1 with residuals +3.35 cm width, -5.18 cm height, +5.18 cm depth.

The cantilevered arm SURVIVED and is continuous. A vertex-count-by-height profile over 32 bands has no empty band between 0 and 184.8 cm, and the stem's cross-section is a solid tube of about 4.3-5.1 cm by 5.2-5.7 cm sampled at 33, 63, 93 and 121 cm height. The heavy disc base is about 38 cm across at 0-10 cm, the drum shade about 45 cm across hanging at 131-161 cm well clear of the base, and the arc apex is still about 5 cm thick at 170-185 cm. The arm neither snapped nor fused to the shade.

Unlit as required: the single material's emissiveFactor was [1,1,1] as generated and has been set to [0,0,0]; its emissive texture is black anyway (sampled max 1 of 255). The file contains no KHR_lights_punctual and no light nodes, so it emits nothing and casts no beam.
Not inspected in a render; no render was available to this agent. All geometry claims above are read from vertex positions in the GLB.
PBR textures resized to 1024 px, so the brass patina and linen weave are softer than the source sheet.
